title: Modified Nucleic Acid Extraction Protocol for Humic-Rich Permafrost Peat Samples
author: Yueh-Fen Li

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the workspace and reagents for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Preheat the water bath to 60 ˚C.
Warm phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (PCI) (25:24:1, pH8.0) from 4 ˚C to room temperature (RT) in a fume hood.
Warm solution PM1 in the pre-heated water bath for 15 min.
Clean the workspace and pipettes with RNaseZap to remove RNase contamination.

steps.title: Sample Loading and Initial Lysis
steps.instruction: Add peat sample and lysis reagents to the bead tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 to 10 g of peat slurry (preserved in Lifeguard) to a 50-ml bead tube.
In the fume hood, add 15 ml PM1 and 5 ml PCI (take reagent from the lower organic layer) to the tube.
Shake to mix.

steps.title: Mechanical Lysis and Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample and separate the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the cap is firmly tightened and place the tube on the Vortex-Genie 2 mixer adapter in the fume hood.
Vortex at maximum speed for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 6 min at RT.
Transfer the aqueous phase of the supernatant (approximately 18-24 ml) to a new 50 ml tube and record the volume.

steps.title: Nucleic Acid Precipitation and Purification
steps.instruction: Perform initial precipitation and column binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/3 volume of C3 (about 6-8 ml) to the transferred supernatant, invert 4-6 times to mix, and place on ice for 5 min.
Centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 6 min at RT.
Transfer the supernatant into two 50 ml tubes (about 10-12.5 ml each).
Add 1 volume of PM3 (about 10-12.5 ml) and 1 volume of absolute ethanol (10-12.5 ml) to each tube and invert 4-6 times to mix.
Transfer the sample to the column tube and centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 2 min at RT; discard flow-through and repeat until all liquid is processed.

steps.title: Column Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove contaminants and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 16 ml of C5 to the column, centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 2 min at RT, and discard flow-through.
Add 16 ml absolute ethanol to the column, centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 2 min at RT, and discard flow-through; repeat this wash once more.
Dry the column by centrifuging at 4,500 x g for 8 min at RT.
Place the column in a new 50 ml tube and leave the cap off for 10 min in the fume hood to evaporate remaining ethanol.

steps.title: Nucleic Acid Elution and Precipitation
steps.instruction: Elute nucleic acids and precipitate them overnight.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 ml nuclease-free water to the column, let sit at RT for 1 min, then centrifuge at 4,500 x g for 2 min at RT; discard the column after elution.
Add 1/10 volume of 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) (5 ml) and swirl to mix.
Add 2.5-3 volumes of cold absolute ethanol (kept at -80 ˚C) to bring the total volume to about 20 ml and invert 4-6 times to mix.
Incubate tubes at -80 ˚C overnight.

steps.title: Pellet Recovery and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Recover the total nucleic acid pellet and resuspend in buffer.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool the centrifuge to 4 ˚C, thaw samples slightly, and warm PCI to RT in the fume hood.
Centrifuge at 4,500 x g at 4 ˚C for 35 min and carefully decant the supernatant.
Wash the pellet with 5 ml cold 70% ethanol (kept at -20 ˚C) and centrifuge at 4,500 x g at 4 ˚C for 15 min; decant the supernatant.
Invert tubes on a Kimwipe in the fume hood to air dry the pellet for approximately 15 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 105 µl of TE buffer, washing the tube walls and flicking to mix.

steps.title: Sample Aliquoting and Preparation
steps.instruction: Divide the sample for DNA and RNA recovery.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the resuspension into two 2 ml tubes: 35 µl for DNA recovery and 65 µl for RNA recovery (remaining volume is optional for agarose gel check).
Preheat heat block to 37 ˚C and place reagents from -20 ˚C and 4 ˚C on ice.
Prepare a 1% agarose gel for quality check (optional).

steps.title: DNase Treatment for RNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the RNA recovery aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a DNase master mix for 6.5 reactions containing: 10x DNase buffer (65 µl), RNaseOut (13 µl), DNase (6.5 µl), and ddH2O (143 µl).
Aliquot 35 µl of the master mix to the RNA recovery tube and pipette up and down to mix.
Incubate at 37 ˚C for 25 min.

steps.title: RNase Treatment for DNA Recovery
steps.instruction: Remove RNA from the DNA recovery aliquot.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl of RNase A (10 mg/ml) to each DNA recovery tube and flick to mix.
Incubate at 37 ˚C for 20 min.

steps.title: Phase Separation for DNA and RNA
steps.instruction: Use PCI and chloroform to purify DNA and RNA fractions.

substeps.instruction: Add 414 µl TE buffer to the DNA recovery tube and 350 µl TE buffer to the RNA recovery tube to reach a final volume of 550 µl each.
Add 1 volume of PCI (550 µl) to the samples, shake vigorously for 15 s, and let sit at RT for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 18,000 x g for 3 min at RT and transfer the top aqueous layer (about 500 µl) to a new 2-ml tube.
Add 1 volume of chloroform to the samples, shake vigorously for 15 s, and let sit at RT for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 18,000 x g for 3 min at RT and transfer the top aqueous layer (about 450 µl) to a new 2-ml tube.

steps.title: Final Precipitation and Purification
steps.instruction: Perform final precipitation of DNA and RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) (about 45 µl).
Add linear acrylamide (5 mg/ml) to a final concentration of 10-20 µg/ml (about 1.5 µl) and flick to mix.
Add 2.5-3 volumes of cold 100% ethanol (kept at -80 ˚C) (about 1.3 ml) and invert to mix.
Incubate at -80 ˚C for 30 min.

steps.title: Final Pellet Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the final pellets and store the nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool the microcentrifuge to 4 ˚C and remove samples from -80 ˚C.
Centrifuge at 18,000 x g at 4 ˚C for 20 min and decant the supernatant.
Wash the pellet with 1 ml cold 70% ethanol (kept at -20 ˚C) and centrifuge at 18,000 x g at 4 ˚C for 15 min; decant the supernatant.
Invert tubes on a Kimwipe in the fume hood to air dry the pellet for about 10 min.
Resuspend the DNA pellet in 50 µl and the RNA pellet in 25 µl of TE buffer, washing the walls and flicking to mix.
Store the DNA and RNA at -80 ˚C.
